field.label: Base Currency
field.description: Primary currency in which the deal premium and values are quoted.

field.label: Gross Written Premium (GWP)
field.description: Total top-line gross premium figure for the full policy term across all lines.

field.label: Total Insured Value (TIV / TSI)
field.description: Aggregate exposure limit or sum insured declared across the entire deal container.

field.label: Broker Commission (%)
field.description: Overarching broker/producer commission percentage calculated on the GWP.

field.label: Payment Schedule / Frequency
field.description: Agreed premium payment schedule installment structure.

field.label: First Premium Due Date
field.description: Deadline date for the initial premium payment settlement.

field.label: Multi-Currency Placement
field.description: Indicates whether payments/settlements are processed in currencies other than the base currency.

field.label: Settlement Currency
field.description: Secondary currency designated for binding and collecting premiums.

field.label: Policy-Level Surplus Fees / Taxes
field.description: Top-level statutory taxes, surplus line fees, or stamp duties applied to the total deal.

components.description: Numeric input with units and constraints

Requested coverage cards with editable titles, requested selection, independent limit and deductible currencies, additional terms, add/remove and reorder. Owns the entire subject coverages collection; do not generate duplicate coverage fields.
Amount with a separate currency selector; the renderer binds amount and currency independently.
Numeric slider with minimum, maximum and step.
Single choice using string options with an index value, or label/value options with a string value.
Secret text input with a visibility control.
Selectable card with title, description content and selection callbacks.
Labeled HTML input with an inline validation error.
